lines.en: label yasuspringchurchgen:
scene yasuspringchurchgen
There are living shadows beneath New Hope Cathedral.
lines.zh: 新希望大教堂底下有活的影子。

lines.en: It is said they walk with extra limbs, assisted by metal rods jutting out of their joints- with white lights at their tips that blink every nine seconds.
lines.zh: 据说它们行走时拖着多余的肢体，靠从关节里戳出来的金属杆撑着——杆的尖端有白灯，每九秒闪一次。

lines.en: Like the spinning of this rock called Earth, they carry on in perpetuity- illuminating the basement where the rabbits die, but never long enough to bring them back to life.
lines.zh: 就像这颗叫作地球的石头自转一样，它们永不停歇地运转——照亮兔子死去的地下室，却从不够久到能让它们活过来。

lines.en: I watch and listen as Yasu reads passages from her bible. And while all of them are vague and left up to the reader's interpretation, I am unable to interpret anything.
lines.zh: 我一边看着、一边听着 Yasu 念她圣经里的段落。虽然那些段落全都含混不清、全凭读者自己去解，我却什么都解读不出来。

lines.en: I watch the way her fingers move- those tiny, spiderlike appendages jutting out of her hand like metal rods in the knees of shadows, and I begin to feel aroused.
lines.zh: 我看着她的手指动——那些细小的、蜘蛛似的附肢从她手上戳出来，像影子膝盖里的金属杆——然后我开始有了感觉。

lines.en: There is so much happening beneath our skin that I can't help but fall in love with the idea of swimming through her veins and chewing on her muscle mass.
lines.zh: 我们的皮肤底下有那么多事在发生，我忍不住爱上了这个念头：游过她的血管，咀嚼她的肌肉。

lines.en: scene black
There are living shadows beneath New Hope Cathedral.
lines.zh: 新希望大教堂底下有活的影子。

lines.en: Three of them visit me on my way to the basement.
lines.zh: 其中三个在我去地下室的路上拜访了我。

lines.en: They carry my body back up the stairs and tell me I'll be interrupting his sleep.
lines.zh: 它们把我的身体抬回楼上，告诉我我会打扰他的睡眠。

lines.en: I ask them when he will wake up, and then they fade away.
lines.zh: 我问它们他什么时候会醒，然后它们就消散了。

lines.en: There are living shadows beneath New Hope Cathedral.
lines.zh: 新希望大教堂底下有活的影子。

lines.en: Yasu Yasui has seen them.
lines.zh: 笠井 Yasu 见过它们。
